title: 'Squandered nation’s best opportunity': Ex-ally Akhil Gogoi accuses Congress of weakening CJP agitation

ai.summary: Congress' former ally Akhil Gogoi accused the party of weakening the Cockroach Janata Dal (CJP) agitation by launching parallel protests, claiming this divided the movement and gave the government room to contain it.

facts.claim: Congress' former ally Akhil Gogoi accused the party of weakening the Cockroach Janata Dal (CJP) agitation
facts.quote: Congress' former ally and Raijor Dal MLA Akhil Gogoi on Tuesday accused the grand old party and Lok Sabha leader of opposition Rahul Gandhi of weakening the Cockroach Janata Dal (CJP) agitation through "parallel protests".

facts.claim: Gogoi described the CJP agitation as the "single most powerful and effective people's movement capable of shaking this dictatorship" since 2014
facts.quote: In a letter sent to Rahul, Gogoi described the CJP agitation as the "single most powerful and effective people's movement capable of shaking this dictatorship" since 2014.

facts.claim: Gogoi warned that the Opposition cannot unseat the government in 2029 without backing an independent mass movement
facts.quote: The Raijor Dal MLA also warned that the Opposition cannot unseat the government in 2029 without backing an independent mass movement.

facts.claim: Gogoi said Congress weakened the genuine mass revolt by dividing the streets and competing with the movement
facts.quote: Gogoi also said that Congress had weakened the genuine mass revolt by dividing the streets and competing with the movement, claiming that the move gave the government room to contain it.

facts.claim: Gogoi claimed that since 2014, the CJP agitation has been the single most powerful and effective people's movement capable of shaking this dictatorship
facts.quote: Since 2014, the CJP agitation has been the single most powerful and effective people’s movement capable of shaking this dictatorship.

facts.claim: Gogoi wrote that Congress launched parallel protests, which divided the streets and competed with a genuine mass revolt
facts.quote: By dividing the streets and competing with a genuine mass revolt, your party weakened the CJP movement, gave the ruling regime room to contain it, and squandered the nation’s best opportunity for a decisive fight

ai.background_note: Congress split from Raijor Dal in September after disagreements over seat-sharing, with Akhil Gogoi claiming Raijor Dal sought 13 seats but Congress offered only four.
